name: csvtk
description: CSV/TSV toolkit with 20+ commands for data processing and analysis

tools.description: High-performance CSV processor with filtering, joining, and plotting
tools.usage:
csvtk stats data.csv # Statistical summary of numeric columns
csvtk cut -f name,age,salary data.csv # Select specific columns
csvtk filter -f 'salary>50000 && age<40' employees.csv # Complex filtering
csvtk join -f id users.csv orders.csv # Join tables on ID column
csvtk plot hist -f score --title 'Score Distribution' results.csv # Generate histogram
